actionResult.summary: 020 Proposal 的总体方向成立，dependsOn=Change.id、Owner typed applicability、activation two-step publish、bounded Manifest writer、write CLI/read-only diagnostics 与 OpenSpec seam 均未发现方向性 blocker；OpenSpec strict、transport/hash/lineage 也通过。但仍有两个 Author contract gaps：authorization-only owner record 的 current Policy gate timing 只存在于 Design SHOULD/Task、未进入 normative spec；Change architectureImpact 只要求 create input，未冻结 persisted/read Change fact。故本轮 changes-requested。

reviewFindings.title: authorization-only Owner record 的当前 Policy gate admission 未规范化
reviewFindings.problem: Design/Tasks 已要求防止 stale/early Owner authorization，但正式 delta specs 只约束 typed target/applicability，没有要求 standalone authorization record 必须在 current Policy 正在请求同一 owner-decision/target 时才能写入。实现因此可提前持久化 authorize-apply/archive 等 record，未来 gate 到达时直接被消费，仍符合现有 spec text，削弱 Owner authorization 的当前 lifecycle authority boundary。
reviewFindings.location: openspec/changes/delivery-change-creation-and-owner-input/design.md Decision 9 / Risks; tasks.md 3.3; specs/flowkit-delivery-change-creation-and-owner-input/spec.md `Owner decision provenance` / `A1 write CLI`; specs/flowkit-policy-engine/spec.md `Owner authorization gate`
reviewFindings.requiredChange: revise-propose：把 authorization-only record 的 timing/admission 写成 normative MUST。持久化 authorize-apply/archive/checkpoint/full-test/delivery-finalize 前必须重新读取 current formal facts/Policy，且 current Policy 正在请求相同 decision 与 canonical target；否则 fail closed、Manifest 不变。同步 Proposal/Design/spec/tasks，避免仅由 Task 隐式约束。

reviewFindings.title: Change architectureImpact 未冻结为可恢复的 persisted Change fact
reviewFindings.problem: 020 要求 Change create input 包含 architectureImpact，但没有规定该值必须写入 Delivery Manifest 或进入 Change/ChangeSummary/ChangeFact 等等价正式投影。当前 canonical Change types 也没有该字段。照现有正式 spec，实现可以接收后丢弃 architectureImpact 而仍满足 create input requirement，未完成 019 Explore P5 与 02 A1 reference 的 Change creation contract。
